blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Two x squared plus three x minus five x squared plus x minus four.
Start with the x squared terms: two x squared and negative five x squared. Two minus five is negative three.
Next the x terms: three x and x, which is one x. Three plus one is four. Negative four has no like term, so it stays.
So the answer is negative three x squared plus four x minus four.

Watch out for these traps. If you forget the minus on five x squared, you get seven x squared plus four x minus four. If you skip the hidden one in front of x, you get negative three x squared plus three x minus four.
